result.brief: 提出观测参照的组织形变预测框架，用可微无网格位置动力学建模工具驱动形变，并加入图谱与周期谐波残差模型，提升手术场景下的未来形变预测精度。
result.reason: Differentiable position-based dynamics tissue deformation forecasting under tool actions; a surgical world-model application with physical dynamics, not a video/multimodal foundation model or representation contribution.
